post.summary: Development prediction from a complete, versioned 59-feature prepared row
post.description: Proposed only. This endpoint accepts prepared features and is not a raw-input preparation API. The present release fails the source audit integrity check and must remain unavailable until repaired and re-pinned. Never serve pre-pickup because actual pickup-time-derived values are required.

syntheticReleaseFixture.summary: Synthetic fixture; not operational source data

200.description: Development prediction. Numeric values are saved synthetic fixture expectations, not re-executed in this audit.

uncertainty.provenance: No deployed prediction interval in this release.

value.target_semantics: dataset_delivery_duration_min; operational event start/end not independently verified

422.description: Invalid schema, missing/extra feature, non-finite value, future feature timestamp, unsupported stage, or schema mismatch.

error.message: Prepared feature set must exactly match the frozen 59-feature contract.

503.description: Readiness, integrity, or dependency failure. Do not substitute synthetic v1 or a numerical fallback.

error.message: Configured model release failed its integrity check.
Configured model is not ready; no prediction was produced.
Configured model dependencies do not match the pinned release.

500.description: Unexpected inference runtime failure or non-finite output. No prediction or silent fallback.

error.message: Inference failed; no prediction was produced.
